description: Python packages from Polign: the polign client for polign_db, and the Recall integrations recall-langgraph (RecallResume, RecallSaver, RecallStore), recall-openai-agents (RecallSession), recall-pydantic-ai (RecallMemory), recall-livekit and recall-vapi, plus langchain-polign and llama-index-vector-stores-polign vector stores.
rules: Each package has its own README under python/<package>/; install the one for your framework, for example pip install recall-langgraph.
Recall is typed, durable memory and state for AI agents; see github.com/Polign/recall for the server and the Python client polign-recall.
